Add_capacity would help if the cause were load, but the timing with the release makes a regression more likely, and scaling won't fix a bad build. Enabling a circuit breaker (memory_b4) protects downstream dependencies but doesn't address a regression on the write path itself. Routing to read replicas (memory_b5) helps read-heavy dashboard load, not write-path latency. I will roll back to the prior build, which memory_b1 confirms was stable, and monitor p99 for recovery within the same window. Settlement writes are heavy, so I will ensure the rollback drains in-flight transactions before switching, consistent with memory_b1's note of no customer impact. If p99 does not recover after rollback, the next intervention window should target add_capacity or regional failover depending on whether the latency is compute-bound or geo-bound.
